sources.label: riley-github/Sphinx-Toolhead
sources.author: riley-github
sources.scope: Native tLW printable assemblies with Sherpa Mini Release 2, Tricorn Long or acquired Rapido 2 UHF hardware. Add a native 2510 axial fan to all patterns and Beacon RevH / Cartographer V4 with original 31.6 mm hole registration to assembled VORON and Monolith heads. Static head body, coil height and manufacturer metal keepout inspected; complete printer travel and cable clearance are not certified. Archived V3 WS7040 / WS9290 adds 10 dedicated native hardware combinations on standard VORON 6 mm mounts; archived Single Inlet Orbiter is a head-only reference with corrected Orbiter seating, motor orientation, author Orbiter support and a derivative rear-bracket clearance relief; axial cooling remains absent.
